actions.summary: Order creation is coordinated by OrderService: it persists the new Order, then invokes inventory reservation and payment-intent services, with transaction boundaries supplied by the local @Transactional abstraction. InventoryReservationService uses InventoryReservationRepository; PaymentIntentService uses PaymentIntentRepository. OrderEventPublisher is the post-submission notification boundary, and OrderStatus/PaymentIntentStatus model lifecycle state. No edits made.
